title: A new city
goal: Talk about feelings and their reasons with all of this unit's converbs, and follow a story about settling into a new city.

intro.text: Feelings come with reasons and moments: *Yalnız olduğum için ağlıyordum*, *Seni gördüğümde sevindim*, *İnsanları tanıdıkça mutlu oldum*. The story of a first year in Ankara uses every converb of this unit.

vocab.en: börek, a pastry filled with cheese, meat or greens

exercises.title: Ankara'da ilk yılım
exercises.passage:
Ankara'ya ilk geldiğimde kimseyi tanımıyordum. İşten çıkar çıkmaz eve dönüyordum ve akşamları yalnız oturuyordum. Annemle telefonda konuştuğumda bazen ağlıyordum, çünkü ailemi çok özlüyordum.

Bir akşam zil çaldı. Kapıyı açınca karşımda yaşlı bir kadın gördüm: üst kattaki komşum Fatma Hanım. Elinde bir tabak börek vardı. Yeni komşusunu merak ettiği için gelmişti. O akşam konuşa konuşa bütün böreği bitirdik.

Fatma Hanım sayesinde mahalledeki herkesi tanıdım. İnsanları tanıdıkça şehri de sevmeye başladım. Ankara'ya geleli iki yıl oldu. Hâlâ ailemi özlüyorum, ama artık ağlamıyorum: annemi her aradığımda ona Fatma Hanım'ın yeni böreklerini anlatıyorum.

glossary.en: in front of me, facing me
to be curious about (also: to wonder, to worry)

exercises.translation: When I first came to Ankara, I didn't know anyone. As soon as I left work I went home, and in the evenings I sat alone. When I talked to my mother on the phone, I sometimes cried, because I missed my family a lot. One evening the doorbell rang. When I opened the door, I saw an old woman in front of me: my upstairs neighbour, Fatma Hanım. She was holding a plate of börek. She had come because she was curious about her new neighbour. That evening we talked and talked, and finished the whole börek. Thanks to Fatma Hanım, I got to know everyone in the neighbourhood. The more people I got to know, the more I began to like the city too. It's been two years since I came to Ankara. I still miss my family, but I don't cry any more: every time I call my mother, I tell her about Fatma Hanım's latest börek.

questions.q: How did the writer feel in her first months in Ankara?
Why did Fatma Hanım come to her door?
options: She was curious about her new neighbour
questions.explain: *Yeni komşusunu merak ettiği için*: `-DIğI için`, **because she was curious**.

questions.q: What does *Fatma Hanım sayesinde* tell you?
options: Thanks to her, the writer got to know the neighbourhood
Because of her, the writer was unhappy
The writer met her through her mother
questions.explain: *Sayesinde* is **thanks to**: something good came from her.

questions.q: What happens now every time the writer calls her mother?
options: She tells her about Fatma Hanım's latest börek
She asks her to come to Ankara

exercises.en: The more people I got to know, the more I began to like the city too.
exercises.explain: *tanı-dık-ça*: the liking grew with the knowing, `-DIkçA`.

exercises.prompt: I didn't say anything because Ali got angry.
accept: Ali sinirlendiği için hiçbir şey söylemedim.
Ali kızdığı için hiçbir şey söylemedim.
Ali [sinirlendiği|kızdığı] için ben hiçbir şey söylemedim.
Ben Ali [sinirlendiği|kızdığı] için hiçbir şey söylemedim.

reject.answer: Ali sinirlendiğim için hiçbir şey söylemedim.

exercises.en: As soon as I got home, I called my mother.

accept: Do not worry, I will be back before evening.
Do not worry, I will [come back|return|be home] before (the) evening.
Do not worry, I will be back before the evening.

exercises.question: When did Ece call Can?

context.tr: Sınavı geçtim! Sonucu görür görmez seni aradım.
context.en: I passed the exam! I called you as soon as I saw the result.

options: Right after she saw her result
exercises.explain: *Sonucu gör-ür gör-mez*: **the moment she saw the result**.

exercises.prompt: When I'm sad, I listen to music.

exercises.en: The children came running home from school.

reject.why: Harmony: *koş-* has o, a back vowel, so *-a*.
Harmony: *koş-* has o, a back vowel, so *-a*.

exercises.explain: *koş-a koş-a*: a doubled `-(y)A` paints the manner, running all the way.

exercises.en: When she heard the news, she cried with happiness.

exercises.prompt: Every time I call you, you're busy!

reject.why: *Aradığında* is **when you call**. You're the one calling: *her aradığımda*.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **I did it on purpose**?

why.1: *Bilerek yapmadım* is **I didn't do it on purpose**.

exercises.explain: *bil-e bil-e*, **knowing full well**: on purpose. *Bilerek yaptım* says the same.

exercises.prompt: Bu filmi izledikçe farklı duygular hissediyorum.
accept: Every time I watch this film, I feel different emotions.
Every time I watch this movie, I feel different emotions.
Whenever I watch this [film|movie], I feel different emotions.
Each time I watch this [film|movie], I feel different emotions.
I feel different emotions [every time|whenever|each time] I watch this [film|movie].

exercises.explain: *duy-* has u: *-duk*, softened before the vowel to *duğ*; then *-umuz*, **our**. With *için*: *duyduğumuz için*, **because we heard**.
